If you can read this, your request carried a valid access cookie. A visitor without one is redirected to the login page and never sees these bytes.

Loading app.js…

Ending your session

The access cookie is HttpOnly, so page scripts can't read or delete it — a security property this design relies on. It's also a session cookie, so closing the browser ends the session. To cut off access immediately for everyone holding the token, the app owner runs revoke_token.
